text:
zara: Hey team — small thing from last night: cookie jar was empty this morning and someone left the lid on the counter. Can we do a tiny etiquette so it doesn't become the office mystery jar? :eyes:
leo: guilty. i grabbed a couple when i got in late, sorry for the mess. i put the wrapper in compost but should've put lid back on. :sheepish:
santiago: No worries. Maybe we add a little post-it: 'Please close lid + reseal, refill if you take more than 3' ? :+1:
maya: Or a coin jar? 50c per cookie to keep refills going? Quick and low effort. I can print small label stickers if ppl like the idea. :money_with_wings:
janine: coin jar seems fair. also fridge Tupperware labeling still a thing — i found someone's mystery lasagna from 2021. :grimacing:
zara: Ha. label-maker would be blessed. For the cookies specifically, i worry about sharing allergy info. Maybe we keep a note: "contains nuts" or whatever on the jar when we buy artisan cookies. Could also keep 1 cookie pack that's nut-free as backup.
leo: will do next time i shop. also i'll bring a cheap airtight jar to replace the beat-up one.
santiago: Ops suggestion: tally + shopping list in one place. I made a tiny code block for items we agreed on so ops-bot can ping when low:
```
PANTRY LIST:
- airtight cookie jar (1)
- nut-free snack pack (2)
- almond milk (1 carton)
- oatmilk (1 carton)
- coin jar + label
```

maya: love it. can we add 'sparkling water' too? folks keep asking.
janine: yes pls. also reminder to mark perishables with date. i can leave a roll of masking tape + sharpie in the drawer.
ops-bot: pantry-funds: current balance $12.40. low items flagged: almond milk, oatmilk, sparkling water. Would you like me to create a one-off shopping request? Reply 'yes' or 'no'.
zara: yes please ops-bot. i'll chip in $10 into the coin jar this afternoon. :dollar:
leo: i'll pick up the jar + masking tape on my way home from the gym. ETA tomorrow morning.
maya: i'll bring a nut-free cookie box Monday. tiny victory. :tada:
santiago: added a little sticky note template in #lunch-plans-pins — feel free to grab and tape on anything that needs labeling.
janine: thanks all. also 0% important but 100% morale: who wants the leftover bag of sourdough crisps? will put on desk in 5. :bread:
leo: me!!! :raised_hands:
zara: saved for me pls :pleading_face:
santiago: can we start a very low-effort pantry etiquette doc? 3 bullets max. i'll write one-liner and drop in #docs.
maya: yes let's keep it 3 bullets. draft: 1) label perishables with name+date; 2) reseal jars/containers; 3) chip into coin jar if you take communal snacks.
zara: perfect. closing note: thank you everyone for being chill about it. small fixes and coffee keep morale high. :coffee:
